content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 indicates this service is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; the case provides no evidence of a coding error or a basis to contest bundling. Prior authorization is not required, so missing authorization does not warrant rework. The bundled contractual balance is not patient responsibility merely because a deductible remains, and no secondary payer exists, so nothing is properly collectible on this claim.","action":"write_off"}
